versions.content: When rptLevel2 support is enabled for a ArgumentDataPro- totype with direction IN or IN-OUT and the RP enabler flag is disabled the RTE generator shall write the actual parameter value destined for each IN or IN-OUT API parameter to an associated RP global buffer after the value is received within the generated function.
